description:
Modify the QuickSnap app to properly handle the CAMERA permission using modern AndroidX APIs. The app currently crashes when the 'Open Camera' button is clicked because it lacks the permission in the manifest and the runtime request logic.

1. Add `<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.CAMERA" />` to `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`.
2. In `MainActivity.kt`, implement the runtime permission request using `registerForActivityResult` with `ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission()`.
3. Update the button's OnClickListener to check if permission is granted (`ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission`) before calling `startCamera()`. If not granted, launch the permission request.

Ensure the app compiles successfully after your changes.
